input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: This is a direction check, and the agreement contains no most-favoured-nation, "best terms" or "no less favourable" provision at all: searches for those phrases return nothing, and a full read of the single operative section confirms none exists. The Fees and Payment clause (Section 5, p0023) is a straightforward revenue-share and sequential-liability provision with no obligation for AP to extend Kubient any pricing or terms it gives to third parties. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly preserves AP's freedom to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties, which is inconsistent with any implied MFN burden on us. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is warranted. We note only that the agreement likewise grants AP no MFN in its favour, which is welcome but not required by this rule and is a commercial negotiation point rather than a deviation.
